name.ja: こんにちは！あたしはアリアです！

about-content.en:
My name is Aria!!

Im an 18 year old transgender girl from the United States that came out in October of 2022.

I have a multitude of hobbies and interests, but ive been trying to minimize them atleast a little to save my sanity and attention span. Those include a deep love for gaming, music and programming (stereotypical, i know). Learning is another thing i especially enjoy. Different fields of science like Biology, Evolution, andVirology. Other things such as language learning - Japanese and Maori being my main focuses - and history; especially around Indigenous peoples throughout the world.

about-gaming.en:
Ive had a deep love for gaming since i was very little; the first i ever played was 'Kirby and the Amazing Mirror' on the Gameboy Advanced, but for the past few years ive been infactuated with Rhythm & Competitive FPS games.

Rhythmically; I first started with 'Beat Saber' in winter 2021, managing to climb the global leaderboard (beatleader) relatively quickly in a short-ish amount of time - roughly 2 years - reaching around global rank 8,000.
Then, i upgraded to Osu! Standard, Taiko and a Quaver over mania.
In standard i prefer low AR and tech play styles, Taiko i just play and really think it needs much more attention and love.

FPS wise; I started with Black Ops 2 when i was very young - around 2016/17 - on the Xbox 360. In 2018 i got an Xbox One and was able to play the newer titles and have every single year since then.

More recently though, Ive involved myself heavily with the competitive FPS scene. Playing Overwatch, Marvel Rivals, The Finals, and Rainbow Six Siege (mostly these few, ive dipped my toes into others but they didnt stick).

In Overwatch ive peaked at rank #243 in support, Masters 3 in DPS, and Diamond 1 in Tank.
In Marvel Rivals ive peaked Grandmaster 1.
In The Finals ive peaked at Diamond 1.
In Rainbow Six Siege ive peaked at Diamond 2. (Ranked 2.0 and 3.0).

about-music.en:
Music is a more recent hobby of mine but i have a tiny history with it. In early grade school i was in my school's band class as a clarinet player. I havent touched music since until a April-ish of 2026 where ive begun working with VOCALOID, CeVIO and UTAU voice synthesizers (mostly UTAU), making covers of popular songs with a select few voicebanks i absolutely ADORE most.

 I post short form covers on my Instagram, Youtube and Tiktok - mostly using Adachi Rei, KAFU and Ui over everything else. I prefer to stay away from the more popular voicebanks like Kasane Teto, Hatsune Miku, Kagamine Rin/Len, and Megurine Luka as i feel they are overused and have a lot of competition in the community. BUT, i still do use them from time to time, just not as much as my main girls.
